liz: Drafted troubleshooting doc updates for 429s/timeouts and pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601
liz: Main checklist: add Retry-After handling examples, show JS/Python/Go backoff snippets, document 413 for over-max-context, and describe fallback header behavior. Can folks quick-review?
hanna: Quick pass: separate burst 429s from sustained capacity 429s. For ops include concrete checks: Console requests_per_minute, allocation usage, and trace-id lookup.
liz: Added an ops checklist and a short token-checker snippet for migration notes. Also included note that older SDKs trimmed contexts silently; new behavior returns 413.
matt: For examples, add AbortController in JS and prefer Retry-After header if present. Also mention we may return Retry-After: 0 for very short bursts; recommend min wait of 200ms.
ops-bot: Remember to add a changelog entry under docs/changes and request runtime sign-off for fallback wording.
liz: Done. Also added header note: x-rw-fallback=true when fallback used. Filing follow-up for Dedicated on-prem YAML.
hanna: LGTM pending runtime approval and link fixes.
